board: Raspberry Pi Zero W first generation, soldered 40-pin header
os: Raspberry Pi OS Lite 32-bit, current supported libcamera stack
aptInstallSuggestion: sudo apt install --no-install-recommends python3-picamera2 python3-numpy python3-venv

requiredMetadata: camera SensorTimestamp and its clock domain
camera.clockRule: Do not subtract Pi and Mac monotonic clocks without a measured mapping. Preserve capture timestamp separately from receipt timestamp.

imu.transport: Linux I2C /dev/i2c-N; sensor-only reader to be extracted without importing robot_controller
imu.timestampMeaning: Existing timestamp is oldest quaternion/gyro receipt on the Pi, not sensor sampling time

motorBusOwner: UNRESOLVED: a separate deployment decision; no actuator runtime in this profile
implementedScope: Dependency separation profile and read-only preflight only
